_remarks.file_purpose: Runtime controls for AirSim train/visualize behavior used by fw.main_with_airsim.
_remarks.json_note: JSON does not support comments, so remarks are stored in _remarks blocks.
_remarks.routing_note: fw.config chooses env_type/action; this file refines AirSim behavior once AirSimEnv is selected.

_remarks.model_visualise: true => visualize framework-model replay in UE5 (preferred alias).
_remarks.model_family: Model visualiser family selector for run_visualise_models (auto|fossen|fhsim).
_remarks.inference_visualise: true => run UE5 inference model visualization.
_remarks.mode_priority: If both model_visualise and inference_visualise are true, model_visualise wins.
_remarks.max_steps: Episode step cap for visualize entry points.
_remarks.render_interpolation_steps: Higher values smooth mirrored motion but can increase visual overhead.
_remarks.show_minimap: Enable or disable minimap support during model visualization.
_remarks.use_ue5_camera_minimap: true => use a UE5 top-down camera minimap path instead of matplotlib map window.
_remarks.ue5_preview_window: When true and camera minimap is enabled, shows the camera feed in a small desktop window.

_remarks.speed_profile: normal|safe|fast|turbo|custom. normal runs near real-time ship movement. safe/fast/turbo apply built-in accelerated presets. custom uses explicit values below.
_remarks.simulation_speed: UE5 simulation speed multiplier during training.
_remarks.use_pause_stepping: true => deterministic frame stepping (recommended for training throughput/stability).
_remarks.frames_per_step: How many UE5 physics frames are advanced per RL step.
_remarks.time_step: Nominal simulator dt used by env dynamics metrics.
_remarks.physics_update_timeout: Watchdog while waiting for frame-step completion.
_remarks.state_poll_interval: Polling cadence while waiting for UE5 to re-pause.
_remarks.max_steps: Episode step cap for AirSim training.

_remarks.use_airsim: Master on/off switch for AirSim bridge usage.
_remarks.ip: AirSim RPC host. Empty string means localhost.
_remarks.save_slot: UE5 save slot loaded before training/visualization.
_remarks.simulation_speed: Base UE5 speed used by visualize path and as fallback when training overrides are absent.
_remarks.status_context: Optional custom text prefix for the UE5 top-left AirSim status banner.
_remarks.status_world_fallback: When true, also draw the status text as a world-space string near the mirrored vehicle/object.
